subject: Request: PO requirement exception for Stride Analytics onboarding
messages:
From: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@strideanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@strideanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding / billing terms

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Attached are the W9 and the SOW for the pilot engagement. A quick note on billing: Stride Analytics operates on an invoice-first model and does not issue purchase orders from our side. Our standard terms are Net30.

If Redwood requires a PO to create a vendor record we can explore alternatives (e.g., a signed SOW plus invoicing contact) but we typically do not provide POs. Please let me know what you need from our side to get set up.

Thanks,
Carl Nguyen
Business Operations
Stride Analytics
attachments: Stride_W9_2025-07-08.pdf (PDF), Stride_SOW_v1_2025-07-08.pdf (DOCX)

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@strideanalytics.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding / billing terms

Hi Carl — appreciate the attachments and the clarity. Looping in Finance (Sergio) and Head of Finance (Grace) to confirm what we can do here. A few quick items so we can move forward: 

- Confirmed spend for the initial pilot is estimated at $28,000 (SOW baseline).
- We need to complete Redwood's vendor onboarding form to create a vendor record (I attached it below).
- Our standard procurement policy: POs are required for vendor engagements with committed spend over $5,000. Exceptions can be approved by Finance on a case-by-case basis, but they require a documented exception request and an approval PDF that will sit on the vendor record.

Options that would let us onboard Stride without a traditional PO:
1) Finance exception: approve invoice-based billing (Net30) for the pilot; exception recorded in system.
2) Create a one-off PO-equivalent: legal or procurement issue a contract reference number tied to invoices.

Carl, would procurement at Stride be able to accept a signed approval PDF and proceed on Net30 invoices? If yes, I can ask Finance for an exception and aim to have vendor onboarding complete by next week.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form-Marissa-20250709.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@strideanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding / billing terms

Marissa — thanks for the context. I reviewed Stride's SOW and the estimated pilot value (~$28k). Per Redwood procurement policy, POs are required for committed spend > $5k. That said, Finance can approve an exception under defined controls. My recommended controls: 

- Limited exception duration: 6 months maximum for pilot, subject to renewal only if procurement moves to PO or we have an MSA with invoicing terms.
- Pre-authorization limit: cap initial invoices to $30k unless pre-approved by Grace.
- Payment terms: accept Net30 invoices, but require invoices to reference the Redwood vendor code and the SOW agreement id.
- Recordkeeping: signed exception approval to be stored in vendor record and a Jira ticket created for audit trace (FIN-234).

If Grace signs off on the controls above, I will file the exception, add Stride to the vendor registry, and inform AP to accept invoices referencing the SOW. Carl — please confirm you can accept these constraints (Net30, invoices referencing SOW id) and that procurement@strideanalytics.com will send invoices to ap@redwood.ai.

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Manager, Finance & Procurement
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@strideanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding / billing terms — Exception approval

Folks — I approve the exception for Stride Analytics for the pilot engagement under the controls Sergio outlined above. Conditions: 

- Exception window: 2025-07-14 through 2025-01-14 (6 months).
- Maximum authorized invoices in the window: $50,000. Any invoice beyond that requires re-approval.
- AP must tag all invoices with Redwood vendor code VND-5781 and SOW ref DL-2025-0421.
- Require a signed copy of this exception approval to be uploaded to the vendor profile (attached).

Sergio — please create FIN-234 and update the vendor registry. Marissa — proceed with onboarding and ask Carl to send the first invoice to ap@redwood.ai referencing the SOW.

I attached the signed exception approval PDF for the vendor record.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Finance
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
attachments: po-exception-approval-Marissa-20250714.pdf (PDF)
